decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound sits close to the core seasonal offer, comes as a multi-model line, and is featured on the home page, so it likely sells well.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is a core product type for this Erzgebirge-style workshop and is promoted on the home page.
Although distant from the traditional offer, the electronic music box line is presented as a flagship, so management will give it time to establish itself.
The motif platform is an accessory supporting the flagship music box system, so it is kept while that system is developed, though its lower visibility adds some risk.
The Christmas motif platform complements the music box line and fits the seasonal focus, but its low prominence makes it a possible candidate for range trimming.
A Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established craftsmanship, appeals to collectors and tourists, and is shown on the home page.
